spec.name: Orange Kitchen Chopping Board
spec.description: Warm ivory countertop cabinet topped with a thick, stepped end-grain chopping board. An inset steel knife, brass cabinet pulls and a hanging side handle create a clear kitchen silhouette.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Chopping Board. Solid countertop cabinet with a thick end-grain chopping board, inset steel knife, hanging handle detail and a few subtle chopping marks. Main cabinet collision footprint x0..16,y0..16,z0..16, front -Z. Cooktop props may extend to y25.
